facts.fact: Agence Ecofin (12 Oct 2026) states the Central African Republic has two terrestrial fibre links to neighbours today, through Cameroon and through Congo-Brazzaville, carried on the Central African Backbone (about 935 km of fibre) and reaching the submarine cables.
facts.system: Central African Backbone (CAB) via Cameroon and Congo-Brazzaville

systems.system: CAR-DRC fibre interconnection to Moanda landing (2Africa, WACS)

note: DRC link agreed in principle 8 Oct 2026, no timetable or financing, so not a fact; March 2026 vandalism damaged segments, no route stated cut.
